messages:
jon: postmortem follow-up: recurring night noise still from 3 families: `proxy-conn-flood`, `scheduler-backlog`, `redis-hotkey`. Need owners + concrete short tasks. can we split and set 48-72h monitoring windows?

monitor-bot: 48h snapshot: proxy-conn-flood=38, scheduler-backlog=29, redis-hotkey=21. top services: inference-proxy, batch-scheduler, cache-layer. link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1748509999

kate: I'll take proxy-conn-flood. short fixes: increase upstream pool by 20%, add connect jitter, and change alert to only page when avg_conn_latency > 220ms. PR by Tue EOD. will add `owner=kate` tag.

leo: I'll own scheduler-backlog and help with redis-hotkey dedupe. scheduler plan: switch alert to p95(backlog,5m) and add prefetch cap `prefetch_max=1000`. redis plan: add exact-key dedupe with 12m window and hot-key histogram. targets: PRs by Wed.

jon: good. small constraints: prefer dedupe windows <=15m so we don't hide repeated failures. require 72h monitoring after each roll. please add smoke tests to CI that fire identical keys x3 -> expect 1 pager.

kate: agreed on 72h. will set canary 5% traffic and a Grafana tile with 1m/5m. smoke example: ```bash
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -H "X-Test: dedupe" https://proxy-canary/ping; done
# expect: 1 page within 15m
```

leo: adding test harness entries for both scheduler and redis. also adding a tiny metric `alerts_dedupe_suppressed_total` so we can audit suppression vs real suppression.

jon: please be explicit with runbook edits: include query strings, rollback steps, and a one-liner for oncall. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/night-noise. drop PR link when ready.

kate: will update runbook and PR. PR description will include dashboard + smoke CI links.

leo: timeline recap: PRs by Wed EOD (kate, leo). canary Thu night. monitor 72h after rollout. jon to open tracking ticket and post daily one-line statuses here.

jon: ticket opened RI-10077 https://redwood.internal/pm/RI-10077. daily format: "kate: proxy canary OK | leo: scheduler PR open". reminder set.

monitor-bot: reminder set: daily check-in 08:45 UTC until 1748588400 (72h end).

kate: quick q  dedupe 12m vs 15m for redis hot keys? leaning 12m.

leo: 12m is fine for hot-key pattern; keep 15m for connection-level dedupe. will document both.

jon: one last ask  include a short note in the PR about regression detection thresholds (e.g., if suppressed_alerts > 5% and error_rate_increase > 2x, rollback).

kate: will add the rollback guard in PR checks.

leo: wiring tests now. will post PR links when ready.

jon: thanks all. daily updates here until monitoring window complete. thread locked for edits.
